name: Isononanoic acid
description: Isononanoic acid (CAS 26896-18-4 ), also known as isopelargonic acid, is a branched-chain C9 fatty acid used as a building block and functional ingredient across polymer, lubricant, and personal care manufacturing. Its branched structure drives performance in ester synthesis, where linearity would otherwise limit end-product flexibility or stability. In plastics and polymer processing, it reacts with alcohols to produce plasticizer esters. These esters are used in PVC and other flexible polymer formulations. Metalworking and lubricant formulators use isononanoic acid-derived esters as base fluids and additive components in synthetic lubricants. Low-temperature performance and oxidative stability are key purchasing criteria for these applications. In personal care, it functions as an emollient ester precursor and emulsifier component in skin-feel formulations. Common applications include creams and serums where texture is critical. It also serves as an intermediate in the production of metal soaps and driers used in coatings and ink systems. Isononanoic acid is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. Technical grade is the standard commercial form, with purity typically specified at 99% or above to ensure consistent industrial performance. Bulk supply is available in drums and IBC containers, with tanker quantities offered for large-volume industrial buyers.
